They're not in the same class as those ''AT-ATs'' you and General Rieekan's people faced on ''Hoth''&hellip; but it's no ''picnic'' fighting 'em!|A Rebel major and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Star Wars 47" />}}
The '''Battle of Xeron''' was a battle that took place in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].

==The battle==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] ground troops under the command of a [[Unidentified Rebel major (Xeron)|major]] faced steep opposition from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which sent in its heavy armed [[Imperial warbot]]s. Despite not being as large or intimidating as [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], the warbots were hard to neutralize and a unit was captured in order to outline its schematics and find a weakness that could be exploited in later confrontations.

==Aftermath==
This warbot unit was carried onboard a [[Rebel ship of the line]] which brought it to a rendezvous point where [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] could examine it.
